# Documentation Guidelines – ChromaGlyphs

- All public functions must have TSDoc comments describing parameters, return values, and thrown errors.
- The `docs/` folder holds design documents; keep them in Markdown.
- Update `docs/glyph-format.md` whenever the token wire format or schema changes.
- README usage examples must compile; keep them in sync with actual API signatures.
- Changelog entries go in `CHANGELOG.md` using `YYYY-MM-DD` dates and [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com) format.
